temperature.toHot: {count, plural, one {# more point to turn hot.} other {# more points to turn hot.}}
temperature.guideTitle: How the temperature is worked out
temperature.guideIntro: A score out of 100 that measures how interested the prospect is in this document. Cold below {warm}, warm up to {warmMax}, hot from {hot}. It drops on its own if the prospect doesn't come back, and goes to 100 when the proposal is approved or the deal won.

rows.recentReadRule: 25 if read in the last 24 h, 15 within 3 days, 5 within 7 days
rows.visitsRule: 5 for the first, 12 for the second, 20 from three on
rows.readersRule: 10 with two people, 15 from three on: the document is getting around
rows.pricingRule: 7 from {third} s on it, 15 from {full} s
rows.progressRule: 4 if read halfway, 10 if read to the end
rows.meetingRule: 5 if they open your calendar, 25 if they book a slot

verdict.openedDetail: The verdict comes as soon as Clozer has read this deal.
